Description: New privately-owned housing units authorized by building permits, total; the tournament signals are its year-over-year growth and transforms of that growth
Source: FRED / ALFRED (pinned vintages; U.S. Census Bureau / HUD, new residential construction)
Direction Convention: Higher YoY growth = housing and construction expanding
Known Quirks: First printed about 18 days after month-end (Census/HUD) and revised in the next reports; YoY growth is zero-centred; permits are a leading-index component
Display Note: Signals use year-over-year growth, not the level (the level pair is permit_spy).
Used as the equity-market target and benchmark.
